scripts.api: uv run --project services/api uvicorn finance_agent.api.app:app --app-dir services/api/src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.lint: uv run --project services/api ruff check --config services/api/pyproject.toml services/api/src services/api/tests
scripts.typecheck: uv run --project services/api mypy --config-file services/api/pyproject.toml services/api/src/finance_agent && pnpm --filter @folio/desktop typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm contracts:check && pnpm test:python && pnpm --filter @folio/desktop typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm contracts:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:python && pnpm build && pnpm eval:offline
scripts.demo:reset: uv run --project services/api python scripts/demo_control.py reset
scripts.demo:daily-close: uv run --project services/api python scripts/demo_control.py daily-close
scripts.eval:offline: uv run --project services/api python evals/run_offline_harness.py && uv run --project services/api python evals/run_narrative_guard.py
scripts.test:local-model: uv run --project services/api pytest -q services/api/tests/models/test_lm_studio.py services/api/tests/agent/test_harness_controller.py && pnpm eval:offline
